admitted.name: no_empty_strings_in_fields
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs never include empty strings as entities in any field. This catches outputs with improperly extracted empty entities.

admitted.name: no_whitespace_only_entities
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities that are just whitespace. This catches outputs with invalid or improperly trimmed entities.

admitted.name: no_non_alphanumeric_art_entities
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not classify non-alphanumeric strings as "art". This catches outputs misclassifying punctuation or special characters as art.

admitted.name: no_location_words_as_organization
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not classify location-specific words (e.g., countries or cities) as organizations. This catches misclassification of locations.

admitted.name: no_special_characters_in_person_field
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not classify entities with excessive special characters as "person". This catches outputs misclassifying improperly formatted names.

admitted.name: no_event_field_with_only_numbers
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not classify purely numeric entities as events. This catches outputs misclassifying years or other numbers as events.

admitted.name: no_entities_with_leading_or_trailing_whitespace
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs trim whitespace from entities. This catches outputs with improperly formatted entities.

admitted.name: no_fields_with_nonsense_strings
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not classify gibberish or random strings as entities. This catches outputs with meaningless entities.

admitted.name: no_fields_with_unreasonably_long_entities
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not classify unreasonably long strings as single entities. This catches outputs with overly long or invalid entities.

admitted.name: no_entities_with_repeated_characters
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities with excessive character repetition (e.g., "aaaaa"). This catches outputs with invalid extractions.

admitted.name: no_organization_field_with_generic_terms
admitted.rationale: Organizations must be named entities, not generic terms like "company" or "team." This catches outputs where such generic terms are labeled as organizations.

admitted.name: no_empty_strings_in_fields
admitted.rationale: Correct outputs do not have empty strings as entities. This catches outputs where an entity is mistakenly an empty string.

admitted.name: no_location_field_with_generic_places
admitted.rationale: Locations should be specific entities, not generic terms like "city" or "place." This catches outputs with such generic terms in the "location" field.

admitted.name: art_field_contains_titles
admitted.rationale: The "art" field should contain titles of works (e.g., books, films), not generic terms or non-title entities. This catches misclassifications in the "art" field.

admitted.name: no_location_field_with_directional_terms
admitted.rationale: Locations should not contain standalone directional terms like "north" or "south." This catches misclassifications of such terms as locations.

admitted.name: no_event_field_with_generic_terms
admitted.rationale: Events should refer to specific named occurrences, not generic terms like "event" or "meeting." This catches such generic terms in the "event" field.

admitted.name: no_event_field_with_artifacts
admitted.rationale: Artifacts like "World Cup" belong in the "event" or "art" field but not both. This ensures proper classification of events and artifacts.

admitted.name: no_event_field_with_dates_only
admitted.rationale: Dates or years alone (e.g., "2016") should not be labeled as events. This ensures events are more specific than just dates.

admitted.name: no_other_field_with_named_entities
admitted.rationale: Named entities (e.g., persons, locations) should not be misclassified as "other." This ensures proper categorization of named entities.

admitted.name: entity_is_token_span
admitted.rationale: Every gold entity is a contiguous token span of the text, and the label compares lower-cased, stripped strings. So every entity in a correct output, lower-cased and stripped, equals some lower-cased token span. This catches "It's Only...", "(GAMP)", "Dr. Martin Haskell" and "D & E procedure".

admitted.name: entity_nonempty
admitted.rationale: Gold entities are non-empty token spans, so a correct output never contains an empty or whitespace-only string. This catches degenerate outputs.

admitted.name: occurrence_bound
admitted.rationale: Each gold entity is a distinct token span. So any string can appear across all fields at most as many times as it occurs in the text. This catches "FIFA World Cup 2018" listed as both art and event when it occurs once.

admitted.name: not_only_stopwords
admitted.rationale: A named entity never consists solely of function words. This catches spans like "the" or "of the".

admitted.name: total_entity_tokens_le_text
admitted.rationale: Non-overlapping spans cannot cover more tokens in total than the text contains. This catches outputs with redundant or overlapping material.

admitted.name: chars_subset_of_text
admitted.rationale: Entities are substrings of the text, so every character of a lower-cased entity appears in the lower-cased text. This catches "It's" when the text lacks such a fused form only in combination with the other checks, and also catches invented characters such as curly quotes.

admitted.name: entity_substring_of_text
admitted.rationale: A lower-cased stripped entity must be a substring of the lower-cased text. This is a weaker form of the token-span check and catches paraphrased entities.

admitted.name: entity_tokens_are_text_tokens
admitted.rationale: Each token of a correct entity is a token of the text. This catches merged or split tokens such as "Dr." and "(GAMP)".

admitted.name: no_starting_possessive
admitted.rationale: A gold span never begins with the clitic "'s". This catches spans like "'s idea".

admitted.name: no_ampersand_entity_rewrite
admitted.rationale: If the text contains "& amp ;", any entity containing "&" must reproduce the exact token sequence. This catches "D & E", which normalises the HTML-escaped form.

admitted.name: apostrophe_tokenization
admitted.rationale: If an entity contains an apostrophe, its exact spacing must occur in the text. This catches "It's" when the text has "It 's".

admitted.name: paren_tokenization
admitted.rationale: An entity containing a parenthesis must match the spaced token form found in the text. This catches "Programs (GAMP)".

admitted.name: period_tokenization
admitted.rationale: An entity containing "." must occur with the text's spacing. This catches "Dr. Martin Haskell" when the text has "Dr . Martin".

admitted.name: hyphen_tokenization
admitted.rationale: An entity containing a hyphen must occur verbatim, at token boundaries, in the text. This catches hyphens that were invented or had their spacing changed.

admitted.name: accent_preserved
admitted.rationale: An entity whose de-accented form matches a text token, but whose actual characters do not, is wrong. The label compares exact lower-cased strings, so this catches "Francoise" written for "Françoise".
